sqlMap.select: SELECT KTNET_ROUTE, UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2(UTL_COMPRESS.LZ_UNCOMPRESS(NVL(DIVISION_MSG,EMPTY_BLOB()))) as DIVISION_MSG, INP_D, INP_T, GMT_D, GMT_T FROM TM_TRACE_KTNET WHERE DONE_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT CARR_CODE, SMI_VERSION, IMP_EXP_FLAG, OCI_TYPE_FLAG, MANIFEST_COMPANY, KTNET_SEND_FLAG, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, CONV_MULTI_SEND, IKAMS_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, MULTI_SEND, KTNET_MANIFEST, KCNET_MANIFEST, ORG, DST, SEND_QNAME FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE# AND ROWNUM = '1'
AND (FIRST_USE_D||FIRST_USE_T <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss') AND LAST_USE_D||LAST_USE_T >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss'))

SELECT TRX_ROUTE ,ORG_ROUTE FROM(SELECT * FROM TM_TRACE
WHERE MAWB_NO = #MAWB_NO#
AND HAWB_NO =#HAWB#
AND TYPE_DIVICE NOT IN ('I', 'X') ORDER BY INP_D||INP_T DESC
WHERE TRX_ROUTE = #MSG_CTRL_ID#
) WHERE ROWNUM = '1'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE#
AND IMP_EXP_FLAG = #OCI_TYPE# AND OCI_TYPE_FLAG = #OCI_FLAG#
AND (ORG IS NOT NULL OR DST IS NOT NULL)
AND (FIRST_USE_D||FIRST_USE_T <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss') AND LAST_USE_D||LAST_USE_T >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss'))

SELECT CARR_CODE, SMI_VERSION, IMP_EXP_FLAG, OCI_TYPE_FLAG, MANIFEST_COMPANY, DECODE(#REPROC_KT_FLAG#, 'Y', KTNET_SEND_FLAG, '') AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG, DECODE(#REPROC_KT_MANIFEST#, 'Y', KTNET_MANIFEST, '') AS KTNET_MANIFEST, DECODE(#REPROC_OAL_FLAG#, 'Y', AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, '') AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_OAL_VER#, 'Y', AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, '') AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, DECODE(#REPROC_KE_FLAG#, 'Y', CONV_MULTI_SEND, '') AS CONV_MULTI_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_IKAMS_FLAG#,'Y',IKAMS_SEND,'') AS IKAMS_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_TYPEB_FLAG#, 'Y', SITA_TYPEB_SEND, '') AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_TYPEB_VER#, 'Y', SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, '') AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, DECODE(#REPROC_KC_MANIFEST#, 'Y', KCNET_MANIFEST, '') AS KCNET_MANIFEST, MULTI_SEND, ORG, DST, SEND_QNAME, KTNET_SEND_FLAG AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG2, KTNET_MANIFEST AS KTNET_MANIFEST2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER2, CONV_MULTI_SEND AS CONV_MULTI_SEND2, IKAMS_SEND AS IKAMS_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER2, KCNET_MANIFEST AS KCNET_MANIFEST2 FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE# AND SMI_VERSION = #VERSION#
AND IMP_EXP_FLAG = #OCI_TYPE# AND OCI_TYPE_FLAG = #OCI_FLAG#
AND (ORG = DECODE(#M_ORG#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_ORG#) OR DST = DECODE(#M_DST#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_DST#))
AND TRANSSHIPMENT = #TRANSSHIPMENT#
AND (FIRST_USE_D||FIRST_USE_T <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss') AND LAST_USE_D||LAST_USE_T >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss'))

SELECT CARR_CODE, SMI_VERSION, IMP_EXP_FLAG, OCI_TYPE_FLAG, MANIFEST_COMPANY, KTNET_SEND_FLAG, KTNET_MANIFEST, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, CONV_MULTI_SEND, IKAMS_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, KCNET_MANIFEST, MULTI_SEND, ORG, DST, SEND_QNAME, KTNET_SEND_FLAG AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG2, KTNET_MANIFEST AS KTNET_MANIFEST2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER2, CONV_MULTI_SEND AS CONV_MULTI_SEND2, IKAMS_SEND AS IKAMS_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER2, KCNET_MANIFEST AS KCNET_MANIFEST2 FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE# AND SMI_VERSION = #VERSION#

SELECT CARR_CODE, SMI_VERSION, IMP_EXP_FLAG, OCI_TYPE_FLAG, MANIFEST_COMPANY, DECODE(#REPROC_KT_FLAG#, 'Y', KTNET_SEND_FLAG, '') AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG, DECODE(#REPROC_KT_MANIFEST#, 'Y', KTNET_MANIFEST, '') AS KTNET_MANIFEST, DECODE(#REPROC_OAL_FLAG#, 'Y', AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, '') AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_OAL_VER#, 'Y', AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, '') AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, DECODE(#REPROC_KE_FLAG#, 'Y', CONV_MULTI_SEND, '') AS CONV_MULTI_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_IKAMS_FLAG#,'Y',IKAMS_SEND,'') AS IKAMS_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_TYPEB_FLAG#, 'Y', SITA_TYPEB_SEND, '') AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND, DECODE(#REPROC_TYPEB_VER#, 'Y', SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, '') AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, DECODE(#REPROC_KC_MANIFEST#, 'Y', KCNET_MANIFEST, '') AS KCNET_MANIFEST, MULTI_SEND, ORG, DST, SEND_QNAME, KTNET_SEND_FLAG AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG2, KTNET_MANIFEST AS KTNET_MANIFEST2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER2, CONV_MULTI_SEND AS CONV_MULTI_SEND2, IKAMS_SEND AS IKAMS_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER2, KCNET_MANIFEST AS KCNET_MANIFEST2 FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE# AND SMI_VERSION = #VERSION#
AND IMP_EXP_FLAG = #OCI_TYPE# AND OCI_TYPE_FLAG = #OCI_FLAG#
AND (ORG = DECODE(#M_ORG#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_ORG#) OR DST = DECODE(#M_DST#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_DST#)) AND TRANSSHIPMENT IS NULL
AND NVL(ORG,'EMTPY') != 'FRA'
AND ORG = #M_ORG#
AND TRANSSHIPMENT = #TRANSSHIPMENT#
AND (FIRST_USE_D||FIRST_USE_T <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss') AND LAST_USE_D||LAST_USE_T >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss'))

SELECT CARR_CODE, SMI_VERSION, IMP_EXP_FLAG, OCI_TYPE_FLAG, MANIFEST_COMPANY, KTNET_SEND_FLAG, KTNET_MANIFEST, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER, CONV_MULTI_SEND, IKAMS_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER, KCNET_MANIFEST, MULTI_SEND, ORG, DST, SEND_QNAME, KTNET_SEND_FLAG AS KTNET_SEND_FLAG2, KTNET_MANIFEST AS KTNET_MANIFEST2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND2, AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER AS AIR_PIMA_MSB_SEND_VER2, CONV_MULTI_SEND AS CONV_MULTI_SEND2, IKAMS_SEND AS IKAMS_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND2, SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER AS SITA_TYPEB_SEND_VER2, KCNET_MANIFEST AS KCNET_MANIFEST2 FROM TC_FHL_CARR_ROUTINGLIST WHERE CARR_CODE =#CARR_CODE# AND SMI_VERSION = #VERSION#
AND IMP_EXP_FLAG = #OCI_TYPE# AND OCI_TYPE_FLAG = #OCI_FLAG#
AND (ORG = DECODE(#M_ORG#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_ORG#) OR DST = DECODE(#M_DST#, 'SEL', 'ICN', #M_DST#)) AND TRANSSHIPMENT IS NULL
AND NVL(ORG,'EMTPY') != 'FRA'
AND ORG = #M_ORG#
AND TRANSSHIPMENT = #TRANSSHIPMENT#
AND (FIRST_USE_D||FIRST_USE_T <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss') AND LAST_USE_D||LAST_USE_T >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMddhh24Miss'))

SELECT A.MAWB_## AS MAWB_NO ,A.HAWB_## AS HAWB_NO ,A.M_ORG AS M_ORG ,A.M_DST AS M_DST ,A.M_PC_Q AS M_PC_Q ,A.M_WT_M AS M_WT_M ,A.CMOD_N AS CMOD_N ,A.MSG_CTRL_ID AS MSG_CTRL_ID ,A.SUCCESS_FLAG AS SUCCESS_FLAG ,A.SENDER_PIMA AS SENDER_PIMA ,A.FAIL_MSG AS FAIL_MSG ,BLOB_TO_CLOB(B.ORG_MSG) AS ORG_MSG FROM IF_TX_EXP_HAWB_SUCCESS_FLAG A , IF_TX_EXP_HAWB B WHERE A.MSG_CTRL_ID = B.MSG_CTRL_ID AND A.DONE_YN = #IKAMS_DONE_YN# ORDER BY B.MSG_CTRL_ID

SELECT A.MAWB_## AS MAWB_NO ,SUBSTR(A.MAWB_##,0,3) AS MAWB_PRIFIX ,SUBSTR(A.MAWB_##,4,11) AS MAWB_SERIAL ,A.HAWB_## AS HAWB_NO ,A.M_ORG AS M_ORG ,A.M_DST AS M_DST ,B.FLT_D AS FLT ,A.M_PC_Q AS M_PC_Q ,A.M_WT_M AS M_WT_M ,A.CMOD_N AS CMOD_N ,A.MSG_CTRL_ID AS MSG_CTRL_ID ,A.SUCCESS_FLAG AS SUCCESS_FLAG ,A.KAMS_UPDT_YN AS KAMS_UPDT_YN ,A.WORKTYPE AS WORKTYPE ,A.SENDER_PIMA AS SENDER_PIMA ,B.MSG_TYPE AS MSG_TYPE ,B.CARR_C AS CARR_C ,B.FLT_## AS FLT_NUM ,B.H_PC_Q AS H_PC_Q ,B.H_WT_M AS H_WT_M ,B.SLAC AS SLAC ,BLOB_TO_CLOB(B.ORG_MSG) AS ORG_MSG FROM IF_TX_IMP_HAWB_SUCCESS_FLAG A , IF_TX_IMP_HAWB B WHERE A.MSG_CTRL_ID = B.MSG_CTRL_ID AND A.DONE_YN = #IKAMS_DONE_YN# ORDER BY B.MSG_CTRL_ID
SELECT PIMA ,KOR_NAME ,ENG_NAME ,COUNTRY_CODE ,CITY_CODE ,PIMA_TYPE ,AGT_CODE ,CSTM_COD_C ,IMP_ROUTE ,IMP_USE_FLAG ,AMS_USE_FLAG ,KCNETCODE ,EZC_PIMA FROM TC_PIMA WHERE PIMA = #PIMA_CODE#
